scientific_scope: simulated WDM to simulated Bell fidelity only
multiplicity_correction: Holm over three exact paired seed-level sign-flip tests

resource_accounting.status: model-based energy and latency estimates; not hardware measurements

decision_rules.distribution: PURIFY if mu-k*sigma >= threshold; HALT if mu+k*sigma < threshold; otherwise bounded WAIT then terminal decision by mu
decision_rules.reactive: threshold the last simulated observed fidelity without forecasting
decision_rules.persistence: forecast the next simulated fidelity with the last observed simulated fidelity and calibration-tail RMS uncertainty
decision_rules.safety: OOD or sigma > 0.20 forces a proposed PURIFY to HALT
decision_rules.bbpssw: expected useful output uses the existing analytical BBPSSW success probability and output fidelity

sandbox_policy_audit.purpose: detect action saturation independently of predictor score

claim_limit: No measured WDM or measured quantum target is used. No winner is selected or tuned on test data. Domain-shift results are secondary and descriptive.
